stage0090_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:

stage0090_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:

stage0090_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:

stage0090_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:

stage0090_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ロビー$$

stage0090_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$ロビー$$

stage0090_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:

stage0090_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$n

stage0090_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$グーラ$$

stage0090_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$

stage0090_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$グーラ$$

stage0090_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$グーラ$$

stage0090_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$グーラ$$

stage0090_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$

stage0090_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:

$$正太郎$$
「$$グーラ$$!

stage0090_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Enough, $$正太郎$$!

stage0090_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Prepare yourself, $c!
　I'll defeat you here and

stage0090_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$グーラ$$... is fighting the only way...」

stage0090_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Damn it!
　Am I... going to lose!?」

stage0090_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Stop it, $$グーラ$$!
　You can't keep this up!」

stage0090_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Silence, $$正太郎$$!
　I am the Demon Beast Prince,
　$$グーラ・キング・Ｊｒ．$$!」

stage0090_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Damn you, $c!

stage0090_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Stop it, $$グーラ$$!
　I don't want to fight you!」

stage0090_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Silence, $$正太郎$$!
　I am the Demon Beast Prince,
　$$グーラ・キング・Ｊｒ．$$!」

stage0090_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「I've given you a portion of my power.
　Show me you can wield it well」

stage0090_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Are you still going to fight, $$グーラ$$!」

stage0090_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Don't think I'm the same as before!
　With Father's power, my combat
　strength has been amplified many times over!」

stage0090_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$赤木$$
「Making his own son fight,

stage0090_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「This isn't a parent's love!
　You're just using your child as a tool!」

stage0090_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Roar all you like, Earthlings.
　This is the truth of the universe」

stage0090_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Now, here I come, $$正太郎$$!
　My fight won't end until I defeat you all!」

stage0090_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$ワッ太$$

stage0090_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$

stage0090_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:

stage0090_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:

stage0090_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$グーラ$$

stage0090_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:

stage0090_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$正太郎$$

stage0090_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$正太郎$$

stage0090_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:

stage0090_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:

stage0090_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$タケル$$

stage0090_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:

stage0090_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$グーラ$$

stage0090_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:

stage0090_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$グーラ$$
「I am $$グーラ・キング・Ｊｒ．$$.

stage0090_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Here I come, $$正太郎$$!

stage0090_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$正太郎$$
「You're my friend!

stage0090_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$正太郎$$
「I'll stop you with my own strength,
　and free you from this fight!!」

stage0090_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$グーラ$$
「That's more like it, $$正太郎$$!」

stage0090_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:

「Sounds like $$グーラ$$ broke free

stage0090_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:

$$竜馬$$
「Butt out, you overprotective old man!」

stage0090_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「He chose to fight of his own will.

stage0090_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$

stage0090_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$グーラ$$
「...That's not... what I'm fighting for...」

stage0090_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Here I come, $$正太郎$$!　$c!

「Demon Beast Prince $$グーラ・キング・Ｊｒ．$$

stage0090_04:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:

stage0090_04:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Thank you, $$正太郎$$.

「$$グーラ$$ left $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s side.

stage0090_04:r_653b741d07545dff.text:

stage0090_04:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$カグラ$$

stage0090_04:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:

stage0090_04:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$グーラ$$

stage0090_04:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$グーラ$$

stage0090_04:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Naive, $$正太郎$$!

stage0090_04:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:

　$$鉄人$$ and I fight for Earth's sake!」

stage0090_04:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$正太郎$$

stage0090_04:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Enough, $$正太郎$$!

stage0090_04:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Here I come!
　Let's settle this, $$正太郎$$!」

stage0090_04:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:

「Hey, $$グーラ$$!

　If it bugs you, come chase me!」

stage0090_04:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:

「Is that supposed to be a taunt, $$ワッ太$$?」

stage0090_04:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Damn it!
　You saw through it!」

stage0090_04:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$グーラ$$
「...You'd go that far
　just to stop $$正太郎$$ and me from fighting...
　You're a kind one, aren't you...」

stage0090_04:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Very well, I'll grant your wish!
　I'll beat you, then $$正太郎$$ next!」

stage0090_04:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Not a chance, $$グーラ$$!
　I'll be the one to stop you!」

stage0090_04:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$タケル$$
「Stop fighting, $$グーラ$$!
　You're practically $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s puppet!」

stage0090_04:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Father sent me to Earth for my own sake!
　And conquering that Earth is my mission!」

stage0090_04:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Only the strong survive in this universe!
　I will prove my strength to Father!」

stage0090_04:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$タケル$$
「This frozen heart... can't it be saved!?」

stage0090_04:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$グーラ$$
「$$正太郎$$! And $$鉄人$$!
　This is our final battle!」

stage0090_04:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$グーラ$$!
　We're ending this fight with our victory!」

stage0090_04:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$正太郎$$
「If you win here,
　you'll have to keep on fighting!」

stage0090_04:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Heh... look who's talking!
　But I have my pride as a warrior too!」

stage0090_04:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Here I come, $$正太郎$$!
　Not for Father's sake, but for my own,
　I'll fight you!」

stage0090_04:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Come on, $$グーラ$$!
　$$鉄人$$ and I will stop you!」

stage0090_04:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「$$グーラ$$!
　If you're fighting of your own will,
　I've got nothing more to say!」

stage0090_04:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$グーラ$$
「My thanks, $$ワッ太$$!
　You and $$正太郎$$ opened my eyes!」

stage0090_04:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$グーラ$$
「I'll throw everything I have at you!
　This is my pride as a warrior!」

stage0090_04:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「If that's how it is, I accept!
　Come on, $$グーラ$$!」

stage0090_04:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「But don't get it wrong!
　It's me and Trider who'll win!!」

stage0090_04:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$タケル$$
（The power that let me dive into $$グーラ$$'s heart...
　If that wasn't my psychic power, then what was that...）

stage0090_04:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Don't look away, Mars!
　Or are you trying to show me mercy!?」

stage0090_04:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$グーラ$$
「I'm grateful to you too!
　But this fight is a different matter!」

stage0090_04:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$タケル$$
「That's right, $$グーラ$$!
　I'll meet you head-on with everything I've got!」

stage0090_04:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$タケル$$
「For $$正太郎$$ and $$ワッ太$$!
　And more than anything, for you!」

stage0090_04:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$グーラ$$!
　I'll stand in for $$正太郎$$ as your opponent!」

stage0090_04:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$アルト$$
「He's a little brother to all of us, one of our own!
　Anyone who torments him answers to all of us!」

stage0090_04:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$甲児$$
「Come on, $$グーラ$$!
　Before $$正太郎$$, you'll have to get through me!」

stage0090_04:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Trying to get in the way of my fight with $$正太郎$$?!」

stage0090_04:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$甲児$$
「Are you scared?!
　If you can't even beat me,
　you won't beat $$正太郎$$ and $$鉄人$$ either!」

stage0090_04:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$甲児$$
「Because he's the kindest, strongest guy there is!」

stage0090_04:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$グーラ$$
「I know that without you telling me!」

stage0090_04:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$赤木$$
「All right, come on, $$グーラ$$!
　I'll be your first opponent!」

stage0090_04:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$グーラ$$
「This one...!
　He doesn't give off any killing intent at all!」

stage0090_04:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$赤木$$
「Of course not!
　You're friends with $$正太郎$$ and the others!」

stage0090_04:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$赤木$$
「If you want to test your strength,
　$$ダイ・ガード$$ and I will take you on!」

stage0090_04:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Heh... an interesting way of thinking...
　Then I'll come at you with everything I have!」

stage0090_04:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$カレン$$
「I'll tell you now, $$グーラ$$!
　I don't go easy on anyone who comes at me!」

stage0090_04:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Just what I wanted...!
　Only against an opponent like you can I truly
　test my strength as a warrior!」

stage0090_04:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$カレン$$
「OK!
　Since it's a friend of $$正太郎$$'s, I'll go all out!」

stage0090_04:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$カレン$$
「I'll take you on at 120 percent!」

stage0090_04:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$アマタ$$
「If you want to fight $$正太郎$$,
　you'll have to beat me first!
　You're not getting through here, $$グーラ$$!」

stage0090_04:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Then I'll show you I can get past you!
　Let's settle this, Mechanical Angel!」

stage0090_04:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$アマタ$$
（$$グーラ$$ is fighting of his own will right now...!
　To put an end to who he used to be!）

stage0090_04:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$アマタ$$
（Did he open the wings of his heart too?!）

stage0090_04:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$シンジ$$
「So you ran away from your father too, huh.」

stage0090_04:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$グーラ$$
「...I just want to test my own strength.」

stage0090_04:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$シンジ$$
「All right.
　In that case, I'll be your opponent.」

stage0090_04:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$シンジ$$
「But I won't lose!
　I'm fighting of my own will too!」

stage0090_04:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$宗介$$
「Asking for punishment yourself.
　A good attitude.」

stage0090_04:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Don't decide that on your own.
　I'll beat you and prove my own strength!」

stage0090_04:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$宗介$$
「Then I will meet that challenge!
　No hard feelings either way!」

stage0090_04:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$$宗介$$
「And when we win,
　you will pick up trash with $$正太郎$$!」

stage0090_04:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$宗介$$
「I do not permit talking back to a senior officer!
　That is the Volunteer Club's rule!」

stage0090_04:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Sensei, it's because I believe
　that someday, you'll work hard together
　with $$正太郎$$ in the Volunteer Club.」

stage0090_04:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$n
「But before that, I'll put an end to what's in your heart...!」

stage0090_04:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$n
「I'll tell you now!
　If you join the Volunteer Club, I'm your senior!
　I'll make that hierarchy clear right here!」
